mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.permission_id) AS statusOneCount, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS userCount FROM role r LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id AND rp.status = 1 LEFT JOIN user u ON r.name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci = u.role COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.description ORDER BY r.id;
